children: White Pearl Acquisition reported net income for the third quarter, compared with a loss a year earlier. Interest income from the trust account and bank more than offset operating costs; the company has not commenced operations and is seeking a business combination.
: Investments totaled $117.7M at September 30, 2026, including $2.7M of interest income for the nine months.
: The company had $1.4M in cash outside the trust account at September 30, 2026.
: The company had not selected a target and reported no substantive discussions with potential targets.
: The company expects significant costs while pursuing an acquisition and has until August 3, 2027 to complete a business combination, assuming no extensions.
